memorable_quote.text: I answered basically the same question four times last year for four different customers.

story: ESG assigned to finance because no one owned it (L4)

interesting: Reporting is driven by customer questionnaires, not regulation (L6, L13)
Asked for a dashboard but could not say what for (L15-17)
